title: Audit PR2287 exact-grid primitive prefixes and shift conditions
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2287's proposed complex layer relies on exact Gaussian arithmetic on one root grid. This package independently proves the prefix conditions for its actual Horner, C/inverse-C and normalization primitives, then checks the pinned implementation with separate integer/rational oracles. No primitive arithmetic defect was found under those conditions.

The proof distinguishes completed-child height from intermediate headroom and requires a valid shift extent as well as exact divisibility. Exact examples show a fitting final result with overflowing Horner numerator, a C numerator needing more height than its output, and a zero value whose oversized shift still rejects. The predecessor's scalar charge safely dominates the proved prefix bound.

This is a scoped primitive audit and quantified lemma. The full recursive height recurrence, native/hosting identities, selected payload, stock/tape/time admission and outer multiplication theorem remain separate. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is proposed.

## Task and overlap

- Base: canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4.
- Assigned card: `uniform-transfer-audit`; scope key `603f341b99f590f17a76`; nonce `811c3101664c04ace52e516ba0bb155a`.
- Refined scope: PR2287 section 6's arithmetic bridge, responding to [Discussion2253](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2253#discussioncomment-18941296).
- Exact predecessor: PR2287 `8c60765b5dea9d862b3b190d55da102a576031bf`. Six unchanged source snapshots are retained with SHA256/Git-blob pins, and their upstream correspondence was checked with Git.
- PR2287 already has sample arithmetic checks and a rounded-child counterexample. This adds quantified primitive prefix bounds, exhaustive signed-word boundaries, complete quarter-grid unit-disk pairs, operation-level oracles and nested cancelled-shear returns. PR2313's Gaussian recovery and the wider-chunk outer-transfer claim in Discussion2291 concern different interfaces.
- Incorporated PR1282 (`851e5232f7c9e105fb6e8f3a7be7a070e7524012`) already proves the signed-prefix/Horner norm argument. Its technique is credited; this audit targets the later PR2287 bit-word implementation and fixed-grid/divisibility/shift conditions rather than recomputing whole-word maxima.

The task metadata records entry and pre-submission overlap coverage. Searches cover open PR bodies, Discussion bodies/comments and local package notes, not arbitrary diffs; no matches would not prove novelty.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.11 on Windows, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-grid-prefix-audit
```

Both normal and optimized registered replays pass and reproduce the complete `RESULT.json`: 87,296 additions, 496 negations, 3,552 divisions, 1,947 dyadic-scalar cases, 4,802 C/inverse-C pairs, 1,078 normalization cases and 20 nested child returns. Semantic mutants removing division or overflow guards are detected by the independent oracle; altered retained source bytes fail authentication. `git diff --cached --check` passes.

The nested fixtures execute the actual primitives but are not the selected R480 payload. Written quantified arguments and finite regression evidence are distinguished in `PROOF.md`. No full supplier cold replay, formal-kernel proof or hosted CI result is claimed by the local receipt.

Hosted status after publication: [Registered research packages run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38687149809) reports `action_required` with zero jobs. This is separate from the passing local registered replay; hosted tests have not run.

## Credit

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`) supplied PR2287's arithmetic, construction, existing controls and precision proposal; its NOTICE preserves the selected supplier lineage. Gareth Davidson (`bitplane`) supplied PR1282's earlier prefix/Horner analysis. This contribution is by AAAmirinu with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, code, writing, overlap research and separate-agent review. No independent human review is claimed. New material and unchanged snapshots retain Apache-2.0 attribution.

## Open next questions

The package's `README.md` and `TASK.json` ask for an independent binding of every actual scalar, remainder kernel, child return and parked value to PR2287's complete-program height recurrence and shift extents. This is the next necessary step for extending primitive confirmation to supplier admission.
